segments.text: Simple has been eliminated from the Singapore Major.
This was elimination. He lost two BO1s on day one.
And those were not even close. Those were absolutely discussing.
13-3 against Faze. 13-1 against Liquid. What is that?
And then full tilted, they went into an elimination game today.
No more. PC game out, bro. Fuck me in the ass, bro.
